entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered when UE is deregistered from the network. UE behavior in this state is defined by substates.

entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE or MME to detach from the network.

entities.name: Attach request rejection
entities.description: MME rejection of UE attach request.

entities.name: Tracking area update rejection
entities.description: MME rejection of UE tracking area update request.

entities.name: Service request rejection
entities.description: MME rejection of UE service request procedure.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: UE local deactivation of all EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: UE switch on
entities.description: UE power-on event that triggers entry to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: Inter-system change to non3GPP access
entities.description: Completion of inter-system change from S1 mode to non3GPP access with PDN connectivity to same EPC.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services TAU timer expiry
entities.description: Expiry of periodic tracking area update timer for UE attached for emergency bearer services in EMM-IDLE mode.
